CN.known: PET110 retained 2016-04-28 CINS original-PC closure period reporting. 2022 Shanghai Yangpu judgment public Wikisource transcription describes Netmarble->Yinhe Juzhen Mainland copyright licence signed 2016-05-02, effective 2016-05-16 through 2018-11-01 (later extensions), and litigant's retrospective statement that an original operation had not resumed due to publication approval by the time of testimony. A copyright licence DOES NOT prove an original 2017 PC deployment or any pet.
CN.gap: 2017 Mainland actual operator authorization for live original classic PC, publisher/approval, independently authenticated 2017 classic PC client/patch, same-service pet tables and issuer logs. Contemporaneous closure + later litigant statement cannot establish a universal zero.

TW.known: PET111 Apr27 period PTT relay of 2017-04-26 operator plan for May1 Dadi realm; level1 pet obtain by wild/quest/pet shop, lottery exclusion, fusion sealed, starter unnamed, Blue Tiger reward through May31. PET112 Aug28 contemporaneous fanpage relay provides Aug30-Nov1 repeat Blue Tiger grant with two account-level cohorts, still not native logs. A 2026 secondary reprint of a 2018 Taiwan Taichung court decision describes 2010 two-year game-operation agreement and a separate 2011 ten-year characters licence; criminal request was dismissed and programme implementation/original-source relationship was disputed, NOT judicial certification of 2017 specific PET build or universal termination of authorization.
TW.gap: 2017 dated directly accessible Taozhu first-party original notice, downloadable authenticated client/patch and same-build pet map/SPR/skills, server-specific Dadi/Sayinas pet eligibility and actual blue-tiger/starter grants; independently read 2018 court original if legal provenance impacts classifying this lineage.

HK_MO.known: PET101 records DigiPark 2011 contemporaneous license to Taozhu for HK/MO service planning. The 2018 Taiwan court reprint discusses a separate 2011 characters licence referring to TW/HK/MO, but that is not proof an independent HK or MO original PC service or shared 2017 Taiwan realm pet table existed.
HK_MO.gap: 2017 separately licensed HK/MO service or proof that HK/MO players accessed particular TW realms, exact build/source bytes, original pet IDs, issued pet events.

KR.known: PET110 documented 2015-07-22 Korean contemporaneous gaming press scheduling classic PC closure for 2015-08-21. 2017-09-15 Inven coverage explicitly relates to StoneAge animated television product rather than 2017 original PC pet issuance; Netmarble 2016 Origins mobile is separate.
KR.gap: Direct archived Netmarble PC closure original and any real 2017 officially relaunched classic PC title/operator/build with same-version pet release or provenance-qualified live gameplay.

JP.known: PET110 retained 2009 4Gamer contemporary DigiPark termination announcement. Independent Japanese PC directory Netgamebm gives classic 2D Windows service end 2010-02-24 17:00, not a dated 2017 re-launch or official pet roster.
JP.gap: First-party 2017 Japanese PC operating reissue if any, exact license, native client/patch, pet table and official issued/captured pet records. Prior closure never means all 2017 possible population zero.

OTHER.known: Bounded 2017 free-source review did not locate another independently verifiable country/operator with an authenticated 2017 original classic-PC client or server pet issue. Modern derivative/mobiles and unlicensed modifications are not original PC region proof.
OTHER.gap: Specific 2017 country, original operator license and period archive, full original PC release/build, authentic 2017 named pet issuance and source hashes.
